nodes.description: HCFC1 is a transcriptional cofactor that acts with the sequence-specific DNA-binding protein ZNF143 and with THAP11 (RONIN) to regulate MMACHC. Hemizygous HCFC1 variants (cblX) and biallelic THAP11 or ZNF143 variants (cblX-like) reduce MMACHC expression, so the cblC lesion is reproduced without any variant in MMACHC itself. Cells carrying these mutations behave as cblC phenocopies, and GeneReviews lists all three genes alongside MMACHC as genes in which a pathogenic variant confirms the diagnosis.
